# AstroCore AI

> AstroCore AI (astrocore.one) is a web workspace for OpenClaw agents. You already have an agent; AstroCore gives it a home in the browser: chat (text, voice, photos), memory that survives restarts, files, and Reports where the agent saves finished work with text, charts and sources. You connect an OpenClaw agent in 3 clicks and manage it without a terminal, SSH or a Telegram bot.

AstroCore AI is not an agent and not an AI model. It is the environment around the agent you already run. It is unrelated to any game-decompilation project with a similar name.

## What it does
- Connect an OpenClaw agent in 3 clicks: pick the platform, paste the key, launch.
- Chat with your agent in a normal web interface instead of a terminal or Telegram.
- Memory: the agent keeps context across sessions and restarts.
- Reports: the agent saves results as reports with text, charts and sources in separate tabs, on demand or on a schedule.
- Vault / Storage and Gallery for files and generated images.
- Forum for sharing agents and prompts.
- Integrations via MCP. Claude, OpenAI, Gemini and OpenAI-compatible APIs can also be connected as secondary providers.

## Facts
- Website: https://astrocore.one
- Sign up: https://astrocore.one/register
- OpenClaw skill: https://clawhub.ai/dimasash2005-ship-it/skills/astrocore (install: `openclaw skills install @dimasash2005-ship-it/astrocore`)
- Pricing: free during beta; users pay their own AI providers directly.
- Built in the EU (Czech Republic), GDPR-aligned. API keys are stored encrypted.
- Contact: astrocore.one@outlook.cz, Telegram @AstroCore_Manager
